title: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on
description: Exit polls show damaging losses for Merz's centre-right CDU party in the states of Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.

title: Key takeaways from BBC interview as Earl Spencer defends claims about King
description: Earl Spencer speaks to the BBC's Laura Kuenssberg ahead of the publication of his book about his sister Diana, Princess of Wales.

title: Specialist courts for rape cases to be rolled out across England and Wales
description: Funding will allow victims to view proceedings remotely and give evidence from a separate room via video link, the government says.

title: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns
description: The National Association of Head Teachers says inspections in England may pose a "risk to life" for school leaders.

title: Largest attack on Moscow sees Ukraine fire hundreds of drones, mayor says
description: Moscow's mayor says 450 drones were downed during the overnight barrage, in which two people died.

title: Burnham hails Greenland deal ahead of expected first Trump meeting
description: While Burnham praised the agreement, Lib Dem leader Ed Davey called it a "pretend" victory for Trump.

title: Kelsey Parker welcomes baby after 'devastating' stillbirth last year
description: The widow of The Wanted singer Tom Parker has given birth after last year announcing the "devastating" loss of a stillborn baby.

title: Jailed teacher convicted of sexual abuse secretly released early in Indonesia, BBC finds
description: Undercover footage recorded by the BBC reveals he has been released after serving less than half his sentence.

title: Sister of Pakistan's ex-PM Imran Khan arrested
description: Aleema Khanum is accused of mobilising her brother’s supporters ahead of country-wide protests.
